en.t: Before long, my mother-in-law fell ill.

units.source_text: 请来医生检查后，下了无法治愈的诊断。

en.t: After we called in a doctor and had him examine her, the diagnosis was that she could not be cured.

units.source_text: 我尽心竭力地护理岳母，

en.t: I nursed my mother-in-law with all the devotion I could muster,

units.source_text: 这样做既是为了病人，也是为了我的爱妻，但从更高的意义上来说，乃是为了人。

en.t: I did this both for the patient herself and for my beloved wife, but in a higher sense, it was for humanity.

units.source_text: 迄今为止，我一直想要尽力做点什么，可是由于什么也干不成，才不得不袖手旁观的。

en.t: Until then I had always wanted to do something with all my strength, but because I could do nothing, I had been forced to stand by with folded arms.

units.source_text: 与社会隔绝的我，就是从这时候开始，第一次产生了想主动做一点好事的念头，

en.t: It was from this time that I, cut off from society, first felt the desire to reach out on my own and do something good,

units.source_text: 我是被所谓赎罪的心情支配着这么做的。

en.t: I did so under the sway of what might be called a feeling of atonement.

units.source_text: 妻子的母亲死了，家里只剩下了我和妻子两个人。

en.t: My wife's mother died, and only my wife and I were left in the house.

units.source_text: 妻子对我说：‘从今往后，我在这世上可以依赖的就只有你一个人了。’

en.t: My wife said to me, 'From now on, you are the only person in this world I can rely on.'

units.source_text: 连自己都不能信赖的我，望着妻子的脸不由得热泪盈眶。

en.t: I, who could not even trust myself, looked at my wife's face and found my eyes filling with tears.

units.source_text: 心里想，你真是个不幸的女人，甚至还把这句话说了出来。

en.t: I thought to myself that she was truly an unfortunate woman, and I even said those words aloud.

units.source_text: 妻问我为什么这么说，她不理解我的意思，我也不能给她作出解释。

en.t: My wife asked why I said that; she did not understand what I meant, and I could not explain it to her.

units.source_text: 妻子哭了，她误会我平时一向用乖戾的眼光看她，所以才会这么说。

en.t: My wife cried; she misunderstood and thought I had said it because I was always looking at her with a perverse, twisted eye.
